title: Concept: Stylesheet import over plaintext HTTP
description: An @import rule that pulls a stylesheet over HTTP in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The import is fetched without transport protection, so a network attacker can substitute rules that restyle or hide parts of the page, including the amount a customer is about to confirm.
applicability: Deployments that render an @import rule that pulls a stylesheet over HTTP into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The import is fetched without transport protection, so a network attacker can substitute rules that restyle or hide parts of the page, including the amount a customer is about to confirm.
